alignments.note: Construct noun with a supplied *the*: no article morpheme stands anywhere in the chain, and the rectum carries a determiner of its own, so the construct takes the supplied one (rule 29).

Anarthrous substantival adjective as nomen rectum: the chain's *of* belongs to the rectum (rule 19) and the supplied *the* that makes the adjective substantival joins its unit (rule 46), headed on the lexeme.

Corrected from an `added` reading of *as*. The nominal predicate of the verbless clause takes the construction-supplied copula (rule 20) together with the comparative *as* the ASV supplies before a bare nominal it construes as a comparison, which rule 33 gives to the nominal itself and never marks `added` — the same reading as `פַּלְגֵי מַיִם` → *as the watercourses*. The unit is discontinuous around *choice* under rule 25, and the ASV italic corroborates the supply without deciding its owner (rule 7). The competing reading marks *as* `added` under rule 30 because this colon writes no preposition morpheme; it is set aside because rule 33 licenses exactly this word on the bare nominal whose function it states.
Construct noun with a supplied *the* on the same terms as the first colon (rule 29).
Substantival adjective as rectum: *of* by rule 19 and the supplied *the* by rule 46, headed on the lexeme.

The ASV writes no English preposition for the comparative כְּ, rendering the whole predicate as *little worth*, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and the two morphemes share one unit, the construction-supplied copula joining it as it does `לִפְנֵי` → *was before* (rule 49's closing paragraph); headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme (rule 23) and on *little* in the target (rule 31). The competing reading gives *is* to the preposition under rule 49, but that leaves the preposition holding nothing but a copula.

review_notes: Corrected: the first colon's italic *as* is not `added`. No preposition morpheme stands in that colon, but rule 33 gives a supplied comparative *as* to the bare nominal the ASV construes as a comparison, citing `פַּלְגֵי מַיִם` → *as the watercourses*; so it joins כֶּסֶף's unit with the copula, headed on *silver*.
The verse's one written כְּ is rendered in the second colon, where it fuses with מְעָט into *little worth* under rule 30.
Both colon-initial *the*s are supplied determiners on construct nouns, since no article morpheme stands anywhere in the verse.
